structured.answer: I understood that in a deposit you put money in the bank for a set time at an interest they fix, 15% tax comes off the interest, and you can't take the money out before the end without a fine that the bank decides and the page doesn't give. But I was frightened that it says there's no deposit insurance, and that in the example I put in 70,000 and was "left with" 68,270, so I'll ask the bank and you before I do anything.

stuck.why: 'ההפקדות שלכם 70,000' and 'נשאר לכם 68,270'. It looks as if I lose money in a deposit. I didn't understand that it might be because of 'בכסף של היום' and inflation
I thought a deposit was completely safe; 'אם בנק קורס, אין חוק שמחזיר לכם את הכסף' scared me and I didn't know what to do with it

stuck.where: The red box about breaking a deposit
